sloka: अयोध्यां प्रतियास्यामि राजधानीं पितुर्मम ।अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि सर्वांश्चामन्त्रयामि वः ।। ६.१२५.१९ ।।
transliteration: ayodhyāṁ pratiyāsyāmi rājadhānīṁ piturmama ।abhyanujñātumicchāmi sarvāṁścāmantrayāmi vaḥ ।। 6.125.19 ।।

translations.english: We wish to proceed with you to Ayodhya, and many wishes to go with you and range the forests and groves without anxiety.
